# Champagne Club

> A private collection of champagne accessories – ice buckets, coolers, glasses, bar accessories and promotional pieces from the great champagne houses. Each piece has its own page in English and Hungarian. Prices are not published; enquiries about buying or selling go through the contact page.

## Main pages
- [Collection](https://champagneclub.hu/en/collection/): every piece, searchable by type, house, period, material and status
- [Champagne houses](https://champagneclub.hu/en/champagne-houses/): the collection by maker
- [New arrivals](https://champagneclub.hu/en/new-arrivals/)
- [Sold archive](https://champagneclub.hu/en/sold-archive/)
- [Collectors' guide](https://champagneclub.hu/en/collectors-guide/): history and advice
- [Contact](https://champagneclub.hu/en/contact/)
